question: Show total July 2026 earnings for retailers linked to distributor 5997

question: Compare retailer earnings between June and July 2026
business_requirement: Execute query answering: 'Compare retailer earnings between June and July 2026'
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN wt.created_at >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND wt.created_at < '2026-07-01 00:00:00' THEN wt.amount ELSE 0 END) AS june_earnings, SUM(CASE WHEN wt.created_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND wt.created_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' THEN wt.amount ELSE 0 END) AS july_earnings FROM wallet_transaction wt JOIN users u ON wt.user_id = u.id WHERE u.user_role = 2 AND wt.amount > 0;

question: Compare withdrawals between June 2026 and July 2026

question: Compare boxes scanned between July and August 2026
business_requirement: Compare business metrics between two distinct temporal intervals using explicit CASE expressions and grouping.
relevant_business_rules: Use CASE WHEN timestamp < split THEN 'Period 1' ELSE 'Period 2' END AS period_name
expected_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' THEN 'July 2026' ELSE 'August 2026' END AS period_name, SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) AS total_boxes_scanned FROM sku_inventories si JOIN sku_qr_points_maps qpm ON si.sku_code = qpm.sku_code WHERE si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-09-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY period_name ORDER BY period_name;

question: Show total box scans for Maharashtra in July 2026
business_requirement: Calculate box quantity using authoritative JGH formula SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) for state.
relevant_business_rules: Box quantity calculation: SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) joined on sku_inventories.sku_code = qpm.sku_code
NEVER use COUNT(si.id) for box quantities
expected_sql: SELECT s.sname AS state_name, SUM(qpm.box_calculation_uom) AS total_boxes_scanned FROM sku_inventories si JOIN sku_qr_points_maps qpm ON si.sku_code = qpm.sku_code JOIN users u ON si.status_retailer_id = u.id JOIN state s ON u.state_id = s.id WHERE s.sname = 'Maharashtra' AND si.retailer_scanned_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND si.retailer_scanned_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY s.sname;
